name: Shakti OBE: modulated 40 Hz (obe45), right hemisphere
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti OBE recipe
summary: An OBE session after Murphy's recipe with the 'modulated 40 Hz' (obe45) signal over the right hemisphere, in front of and below the right ear and over the right angular gyrus, then sleep an hour to 90 minutes later. The 30 min are this project's choice. The vendor has one user report of a floating sensation with this signal and says it should be considered untested.
setting: Lie down in a dark, quiet room. Murphy reports that most OBEs came when users fell asleep about 1 h (or 90 min) after a session, so plan to go to sleep then and use your OBE exercises; he expects it to work more often in 'right-hemispheric' people.
schedule: Vendor rules: at most once a week or every 72 h, never on consecutive days; a series of up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. No more than two series over the right angular gyrus; after that, choose another session design.
notes: The vendor's page for this signal places two coils, 'one coil in front of and below the right ear, and one coil over the angular gyrus on the right side', and says: 'This signal has a constant tone. The correct calibration will be 10mG for either channel, when measured from one coil.' (obe45_consent.htm, 'Modulated 40 Hz Signal'). It shows the signal only as a Lissajous picture, and no OBE page gives a length. This program plays 30 min on six coils together: FT10 and T10 in front of and below the right ear, TP8, CP6, P6 and P8 around the right angular gyrus; two channels stay silent. The length, the six coils and the sites are this project's choices; the program obe plays the same signal on two coils. The vendor's file is not published. It is rebuilt as a continuous 40 Hz sine whose phase swings 3 rad ahead of and behind a steady 40 Hz once every 2 s (about 38.5 to 41.5 Hz), in 1-ms points. The kind, depth and rate of the modulation are this project's choices. Field strength: the vendor's 10 mG (1 uT) is measured at one coil. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The default 1 uT there is about 56 uT at the coil face, far above the vendor's calibration; matching it would take about 0.018 uT, too little for this helmet to draw a 40 Hz sine. Support: one user report of a floating sensation; the vendor says 'you should consider it as an untested signal'. Blanke et al. 2002 evoked an OBE at the right angular gyrus with implanted electrodes; weak-field effects there are untested. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Word-finding trouble means stop using the signal. Right-side-only sessions can bring fear. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
